Name: Duck Duck Farm Easy - New Farm
Author: violetskye5
Description:
[size=4][b]Description:[/b][/size]
A new farm type with more buildings, machines, and animals. This is the easier to get started version.

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions:[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Download the mod via a mod manager for automatic installation or download manually, ensure the compressed file is placed within the Stardew Valley\mods folder, extract all from the compressed file in the same location. Both files must be downloaded and installed for it to work. You need to start a new farm after downloading for the farm to work, it will not add buildings in the right place if you add it to another save. [/color]

[size=4][b]Main Features:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]1 coop with 2 ducks and a chicken[/*]
[*]1 barn with a pig, cow, and goat[/*]
[*]2 sheds[/*]
[*]6 re-growable stumps[/*]
[*]6 chests with items[/*]
[*]forest fish are catchable on farm[/*]
[*]silo with 20 pieces of hay[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Differences:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]8 starter gifts instead of one[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]extra machines[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]paths and some farming areas are mostly cleared of fiber, stone, and wood[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Other Notes:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]replaces the standard farm[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]there are no starter cabins locations[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]made with help from LeeloMods[/color][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Possible Problems:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]missing barn, coop, and shed - missing map files (DuckDuckFarmEasy) - good if you like the layout but don't want extra buildings[/*]
[*]missing farm layout/map - missing content files (DuckDuckFarmEasyContentPack)[/*]
[*]missing buildings and greenhouse is in the water - added farm layout to past save, start a new save[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]
Compatibility:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]works with DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor - go into the duckduckfarmeasycontentpack, open assets folder, delete all tilesheets (leave "Farm_Grandpa2" and "icon" those are the only two things you need in the recolor)[/*]
[/list]
